name: MechanicalParasiteTypeB
identity: Warm dark olive-ochre metallic legless segmented parasite, huge ivory upper and lower teeth, cream-gold conical dorsal and side spikes with ringed bases, ochre spotted armor and plated pale golden underside. No eyes, legs, wings or antennae. Follow the original atlas exactly; do not invent slotted screws absent from the source.
observed_source: reference_review_board.png: five assembled pieces, broad toothed head/jaw, three tapering rear sections, ring-base cones; no visible screw slots.
